bio_draft: FILM is New Delhi DJ and producer Sanil Sudan, who mixes house, breaks and techno and also makes dub techno as Tyrell Dub Corp. His self-titled debut album came out on Qilla Records in 2022, and his EP Miwonowi followed on Remmah. He hosted the Medium Rare show on boxout.fm and has run the Delhi venues Auro and Summer House Cafe.

notes: Release dates for Nihon/ Fuse and MK618 are article years (2025, 2026), not confirmed release dates; MK618 is a Tyrell Dub Corp release so it is left out of releases. 'Medium Rare Cut' in the 2017 guide is the show later titled Medium Rare.

bio_draft: FOPCHU is an electronic band from New Delhi that started as a trio of Kaizad Nariman, Shantam Khanna and Siddhant Subs and later became a duo of Khanna and Subs. Their debut EP Milk Bred came out on boxout.fm Recordings in 2018, followed by Now Showing in 2020 and Tall Tales on Krunk Kulture in 2021.

bio_draft: Kumail is Kumail Hamid, an R&B and soul producer, singer and DJ from Mumbai who is now based in Lisbon. He started with downtempo EPs and the 2016 album Links, released the album Yasmin on Bastard Jazz in 2019, and is now signed to Tru Thoughts, which released his second album Mudbrown in 2026.
